gameDescriptionHtml:
After all these years your bad dreams are back but something is terribly wrong… It’s a surreal and dark nightmare but people seem to be scared and disgusted by… you?

Only the old, sick and unable to evacuate remained in the city. Everyone else fled. Even though there are strange monsters roaming around the city, people hide strictly from you. “You can keep the whole city to yourself, but you are not welcome among us.” – This is the message that was left for you in the letter. The reason is not clear. Maybe you were simply mistaken for someone else?

Game Features

  • An unusual, surreal world that captures the atmosphere of a bad dream.
  • Creative and amusing puzzles designed to surprise the player with their strange, yet consistent logic.
  • Immersive and highly interactive world.
  • Charming, minimalist sketch-style graphics.
  • “Outside the box” point & click gameplay.
  • Original and debut soundtrack composed by Desert Fox.
